name: hover-on-timeline-keeps-hud
description: A pointer parked on the timeline keeps the HUD and its hover card. The bar is hovered, then the run waits longer than the 2.5 s chrome auto-hide, and both the dock and the card must still be there: the preview is the tool the viewer needs exactly while the cursor is on the timeline.

steps.note: The hover path, not a click: the reading under the pointer is what the card shows and what the chrome must survive.
Bounded settle over the 2.5 s auto-hide. This is the only sleep in the manifest: it is the timeout under test, not a synchroniser for anything else.

assertions.note: The card did not vanish while the pointer rested on the timeline.
The dock the pointer is on did not auto-hide underneath it.
